camel_example: aliyun cdn DescribeDomainBpsDataByLayer --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn unicom --EndTime '2020-05-06T07:20:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn beijing --StartTime '2020-05-06T07:10:00Z' --Layer IPv4 --Interval 300
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainBpsDataByLayer按协议分类获取带宽数据
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-domain-bps-data-by-layer --domain-name example.com --start-time 2020-05-06T07:10:00Z --end-time 2020-05-06T07:20:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en unicom --location-name-en beijing --layer IPv4 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainBpsDataByLayer

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name. You can specify up to 500 domain names in each request. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

If you do not specify this parameter, the bandwidth data about all accelerated domain names that belong to your Alibaba Cloud account is queried
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多支持500个域名查询。

不传该参数，默认返回所有加速域名合并后的数据
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的起始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the data entries. Unit: seconds.

The time granularity varies with the maximum time range per query. Valid values: 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). For more information, see Usage notes
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询数据的时间粒度，单位：秒。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数支持300（5分钟）、3600（1小时）和86400（1天）取值，具体请参见使用说明中支持查询的时间粒度
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The name of the Internet service provider (ISP). You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp~~) operation to query ISPs. If you do not specify an ISP, data of all ISPs is queried
parameters.help_zh: 运营商英文名。通过[DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp~~)接口获得，默认查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en: The name of the region. You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp~~) operation to query regions. If you do not specify a region, data in all regions is queried
parameters.help_zh: 地域英文名。通过[DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp~~)接口获得，默认查询所有地域
parameters.name: location_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The layer at which you want to query the bandwidth data. Valid values:

Network layer: IPv4 and IPv6.

Application layer: http, https, and quic.

all: specifies that both the network and application layers are included.

Default value: all
parameters.help_zh:
查询维度。
网络层：IPv4、IPv6。
应用层：http、https、quic。
all：包含网络层和应用层。

默认值为all
parameters.name: layer

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval between the data entries. Unit: seconds
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔，单位为秒
